scope: Actual raw glTF LBS hand/finger+wrist-boundary region against actual runtime HERO broadblade replacement triangles, with the production hand socket and uniform-scale cancellation. All original keys+midpoints only. Not engine, continuous collision, visual crowding, AV or AAA approval. Distances are unsigned sampled-vertex/surface distances. The edge-length lower bound is conservative for the entire selected hand triangular surface; negative means inconclusive, not proven penetration. Expected start/end source-grasp contact is retained and not excluded from reports.
coordinate_system: weapon_local_metres; rigid transform invariance from source_glTF raw scene; runtime PI/floor do not change distances
hand_region_definition: All triangles incident to a vertex with LeftHand or left-digit influence>.05, including boundary vertices
partition: blade any triangle above localY.16; hilt/guard any triangle at/below.16; overlapping boundary triangles are deliberately counted in both
